description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rebase -i --rebase-merges' command. It contains setup routines, test cases, and validation functions to verify various rebase behaviors, including handling merge commits, conflict resolution, label rewriting, and other rebase features.

methods.description: Checks that the given command fails as expected.

methods.description: Verifies that the output of a command is empty.

methods.description: Compare two revisions to verify they are different or identical.
